claim: Operations module encompasses daily per-class attendance with check-in, check-out, temperature, health status, and authorized pickup guardian tracking.
Check-out time validation requires check-out time to be strictly greater than check-in time with system rejection when check-out is before or equal to check-in.
notes: Business rule BR02 / MSG01 from legacy test cases.

claim: Daily Activities module functions as an interactive class feed with rich text, media, lesson tags (#), user mentions (@), and an approval status queue before publishing.
Media library automatically aggregates photos and videos from activities and attendance into dedicated system albums alongside custom class albums.
Facial recognition service provides automated and manual face tagging for enrolled students across media albums and daily check-in photos.
Parent messaging module provides direct 1-on-1 threads, custom student group chats, and class broadcast channels with attachment support.
Attendance reporting provides monthly calendar views, excused vs unexcused adjustments, and late pickup penalty calculation.
Academics timetable module allows creating, editing, and versioning weekly schedules with period assignments, subjects, and parent broadcast logs.
Homework module allows subject teachers to assign tasks by class, attach materials, set deadlines, and monitor student submission states.
Gradebook module provides evaluation matrices filterable by grade level, class, and subject, supporting regular, midterm, and term scores.
Tuition invoice module manages the complete billing lifecycle across Created, Sent, Partially Paid, Paid, Overdue, and Cancelled statuses with dynamic QR codes.
Tuition invoice calculations automatically factor in meal fee deductions calculated from verified student absences recorded in attendance.
notes: Cross-module business logic between attendance and billing.

claim: Fee catalog defines billable line items with pricing rules, while tuition management maps these catalog fees to specific classes and cohorts.
Disbursement module manages expense vouchers with category tagging, attachment proofs, approval workflows, and voucher cancellation audit trails.
Payment reconciliation module consolidates payment sessions and transaction logs against payment gateways to audit transaction counts and net balances.
Multi-tenant architecture enforces strict URL prefix tenant routing (/{schoolCode}/...) with dynamic tenant feature toggles and white-label branding.
Frontend web architecture utilizes Next.js Pages Router with Redux global store, Tailwind CSS + styled-components, and NextAuth.js JWT/JWE session cookies.
notes: Frontend tech stack specifications in agents.md.

claim: Backend architecture exposes RESTful APIs via PHP/Laravel authenticated through Laravel Sanctum bearer tokens with tenant-scoped URLs.
notes: Backend tech stack specifications in agents.md.

claim: Infrastructure architecture deploys containerized web and API services to Google Cloud Run fronted by OpenResty Nginx/Lua reverse proxy and custom domains.
User interface adheres to ECO Design System 1.0 with Yellow #FEC020 accent, Blue #0070CE primary, 4-64px spacing, and Vietnamese typography.
notes: Design system guidelines in ECO Design System readme.

claim: Student profile module (Học Sinh) acts as the central operational hub, connecting homeroom/extracurricular enrollment, multi-parent contact cards, per-student tuition overrides, physical development history with BMI calculation, and filtered views across operations and billing.

Student transition protocols (class transfer and academic year transitions) enforce data integrity guards that automatically cascade tuition fee changes, revoke prior parent group communication permissions, and prune non-aligned subject evaluation records.

Teacher directory module (Giáo Viên) establishes two-tier content moderation permissions (Giáo viên chính vs Giáo viên hỗ trợ), manages homeroom and subject teaching allocations, and integrates with identity credentials for invitation and password management.

Class management module (Lớp Học) establishes a dual-tier taxonomy (Chính khóa vs Ngoại khóa) with purposeful feature gating for extracurricular classes, and enforces safety guards preventing deletion of active classes.

Subject catalog module (Môn Học) organizes curriculum definitions across educational tiers and terms with read-only syllabus evaluation configurations, while providing dynamic administrative teaching staff allocation.
notes: Subject catalog and teaching assignment rules.

claim: Announcement board module (Bảng Thông Tin) provides centralized administrative communications across app/email channels with scheduling, audience targeting, draft-only editing, and bulk deletion auditing.

Polls and surveys module (Bình Chọn) provides interactive stakeholder surveys with multi-select options, separate audience dispatch, real-time result aggregation (progress bars + conditional pie chart), and per-student vote revision audit trails.

Weekly meal menu module (Thực Đơn) provides structured nutritional scheduling up to 8 weeks in advance, featuring automatic class fallback to school-wide menus and granular food traceability (GTIN + lot or internal stamp).
Menu publishing engine supports dual modes (silent publish vs broadcast announcement integration) with asymmetric action matrices (cloning restricted to grid menus).
notes: Menu publishing and cross-module announcement dispatch.

claim: Staff attendance module (Điểm Danh NV) implements rapid single-click check-in/out for high-throughput morning arrivals, 45-day retroactive edit boundaries, modal absence confirmations, and search-time aggregate KPI suppression.

Parent handbook module (Sổ Tay PH) provides a structured 2-tier knowledge base with sibling accordion expansion, drag-and-drop ordering, rich-text drafting, publishing toggles, and cascading category deletion protection.

Parent feedback module (Góp Ý) implements a multi-channel ticket workflow featuring 4 status filter cards, 8 functional categories, 4 priority tiers, internal handler assignment, and 2-way discussion threads with multimedia support.

Event calendar module (Lịch Sự Kiện) provides school-wide schedule management across Year, Month, and Event list view modes, using 3 distinct semantic color bands for holidays, internal events, and parent-invited gatherings.
Event calendar list mode provides calendar date cards and in-line action controls, with upcoming versus full-year temporal filtering.
Academic year module (Năm Học) establishes foundational calendar terms through minimal 3-field forms, dynamically deriving current active terms from system time to feed portal-wide filters.

The Miễn Giảm sub-module provides a centralized catalog of tuition exemption and discount policies supporting percentage (%) and fixed amount (VND) deductions, linked to specific fee items from the master fee catalog.
Discount policies support dual application scopes: whole classes (multi-select) or specific enrolled students, automatically configuring beneficiary targeting and enrollment tracking.

Discount policies evaluate temporal validity against configured academic years or month ranges, automatically transitioning from 'Hoạt động' to 'Hết hạn' upon expiration, with manual pause and termination controls.

During tuition invoice generation, the billing engine checks matching active discount policies by student and class, auto-calculating itemized deductions while providing a default-enabled toggle in the wizard for administrative override.
The discount catalog provides Excel export capability and standard action dropdowns for policy lifecycle manipulation without modifying already settled historical invoices.
The Settings Fee sub-module provides 5 independent configuration blocks with isolated per-block dirty tracking, independent Save buttons, and an unsaved changes confirmation modal guard.
The Sepay automated payment block provides read-only inspection of API secrets and webhook endpoints with eye reveal toggles and monthly transaction log filtering.
notes: Sepay read-only integration and payment history.

claim: The SInvoice electronic invoice block provides collapsible toggle activation, mandatory tax credential validation, permanently masked passwords, and issuance automation toggles.
The Late Pickup & Absence Refund block supports fixed vs tiered childcare surcharges with permanent row 1, and 0-100 hour meal refund advance thresholds linked to school operating hours.
notes: Childcare surcharges and meal cancellation rules.

claim: The Reconciliation Email distribution roster enforces strict regex validation, duplicate prevention, and a 3-recipient hard ceiling with input locking upon capacity.

The Settings Fee sub-module configures meal refund parameters by partitioning non-attendance into Group A (100% fixed guarantee for school holidays/events) and Group B (independent % for main meal and breakfast student absences).

The meal refund calculation engine evaluates student-initiated absences and statutory school holidays against daily meal rates, computing total monthly refund amounts across both main meals and breakfast.
The billing engine automatically reconciles previous-month absences during next-month invoice creation, injecting itemized deduction lines and updating total payable and VietQR payment payload.
Invoice records, payment history, and receipt views render detailed itemized breakdown notes itemizing the number of absent days, refund percentage rates, and holiday credits.
The school event calendar provides 3 synchronized viewing perspectives (12-month year matrix, single-month day cell grid, and chronological agenda list) with 3 fixed semantic color-coded categories.

Multi-day events render as horizontal continuous colored bars across day cells in Year and Month views, while agenda list mode renders tear-off calendar date blocks with direct inline edit and delete actions.
notes: Visual rendering and action asymmetry across calendar views.

claim: Event authoring enforces mandatory title, category, and date span validation, while offering an optional 'Thêm thời gian' toggle for precise start and end times with dirty state navigation protection.
School holidays declared in the calendar interoperably synchronize with the meal refund reconciliation rules for automated tuition adjustments.
notes: Cross-module holiday synchronization with meal refunds.

claim: The class management module separates curricular classes (Lớp chính khóa) from extracurricular clubs (Lớp ngoại khóa) with dedicated tabs, distinct filtering criteria, and role-appropriate feature scopes.

Class deletion is strictly blocked and prohibited for any class having one or more enrolled students (student count greater than zero), preserving student enrollment continuity and accounting history.
Curricular classes mandate a single homeroom teacher with conflict-awareness warnings, while extracurricular classes support multi-instructor assignments chosen from the full staff directory.
The class detail view acts as a centralized convergence hub presenting student roster statistics, tuition schedule overviews, teacher assignments, and immediate operational navigation shortcuts.
The school subject management module partitions subjects across 4 educational stages (TH, THCS, THPT, GDTX) with dedicated tabs, distinct curriculum mappings, and academic year filters.
Core subjects are pre-initialized and protected by MoET curriculum standards, while the primary administrative action is assigning and unassigning qualified teachers.
notes: Read-only catalog and teacher assignment governance.

claim: The subject detail view provides a structured assessment matrix specifying evaluation modalities (Score, Level, Comment) across 4 evaluation terms and GPA inclusion flags.
Teacher assignment enforces unassigned-only dropdown filtering, and unassignment mandates an explicit confirmation dialogue detailing teacher name and subject.
Search functionality supports accent-insensitive Vietnamese matching across subject names and codes for rapid operational lookup.
The school grade level management module partitions educational cohorts across 4 statutory tiers (TH, THCS, THPT, GDTX) with dedicated stage filter pills.
Grade levels are protected as immutable master data with zero deletion or non-standard creation actions to prevent structural database corruption.
Grade-level metrics including total classes, enrolled students, faculty counts, and homeroom staffing rates are computed dynamically from active class records in the selected academic year.
Instant client-side accent-insensitive search enables rapid grade lookup and immediately restores full rosters when cleared without page reload latency.
The Grade Detail cockpit provides 4 summary KPI cards and a full class roster with operational shortcut links directly to Class Detail, Attendance, and Timetables.
notes: Grade detail cockpit and operational links.

claim: The announcement board module delivers multi-channel notification dispatch across 3 transmission modalities (App, Email, Both) and 5 recipient tiers (Whole School, Teachers, Parents, Specific Classes, Individuals).
Announcements enforce a 3-state lifecycle (Bản nháp, Chưa gửi, Đã gửi) where editing is strictly restricted to draft records to maintain notification audit integrity.
The announcement system supports scheduled dispatch and cross-module automated notice authoring from Thực Đơn (Meal Menus), Thời Khóa Biểu (Schedules), and Lịch Sự Kiện (Events).
Single and bulk deletion flows mandate an explicit audit confirmation warning that transmitted emails cannot be retracted once dispatched.
An interactive preview modal reproduces the recipient view layout without requiring premature validation of non-essential form fields.
The school polls module decouples poll authoring from target audience dispatch, supporting whole-school and multi-class cohorts with independent dispatch timing.
notes: Decoupled creation and audience dispatch workflow.

claim: Poll records enforce a 3-state lifecycle (Đã tạo, Đã gửi, Đã đóng) with action buttons (Edit, Send, Delete) strictly restricted to draft status to guarantee ballot integrity.
notes: Draft-only mutability and state-driven action visibility.

claim: Configurable poll parameters govern multi-option selection rules and parental visibility of real-time voting distributions.
notes: Configurable multi-choice and parental visibility controls.

claim: The detail results cockpit displays responsive progress bars and renders visual pie charts conditionally only when total recorded votes exceed zero.
notes: Dynamic visual chart rendering conditioned on non-zero votes.

claim: The system maintains an auditable voter roster per class with full chronological revision history for voters updating choices before the deadline.
notes: Auditable voter roster and choice revision history.

claim: The staff attendance module enforces strict date boundaries (future dates disabled) and a 45-day retrospective read-only lock to preserve timekeeping and payroll audit integrity.
Check-in and Check-out are 1-click direct actions stamping current time HH:mm, with inline badge editing enforcing format validation and automatic rollback to prior value on invalid blur.
notes: 1-click time recording and inline edit rollback.

claim: The absence toggle requires dedicated modal confirmation (Có phép vs Không phép), displaying warning DD-03 when check-in/out exists and disabling row buttons during modal interaction.
notes: Dedicated absence modal and warning DD-03.

claim: Staff profiles support multiple simultaneous roles, inline notes with auto-save on blur, and read-only profile modals displaying role-specific details and assigned class links.
notes: Multi-role badging, inline notes, and profile modals.

claim: Instant client-side filtering by class and role, search-responsive hiding of top 3 KPI cards, and nickname sorting provide an ergonomic timekeeping cockpit for school administrators.
notes: Roster filtering, KPI dynamics, and nickname sorting.

claim: The Parent Handbook organizes institutional guidelines in a strict 2-tier category taxonomy (Root -> Sub-Category -> Leaf Article) governed by single-active accordion expansion.
Sub-categories and articles support drag-and-drop sibling reordering within their parent container, whereas root categories maintain fixed administrative ordering.
Articles manage draft vs. published lifecycles with distinct visual badging, color-coded titles, and 1-click status transitions (Xuất bản / Ẩn) via contextual action menus.
Category deletions trigger high-severity cascading warnings (ST-01) detailing that all sub-categories and articles will be wiped, protecting content against accidental data loss.
Article-centric search and status filtering prunes non-matching categories from the tree and auto-expands branches leading to matching articles, displaying ST-03 on empty results.
notes: Article-centric tree pruning and empty state ST-03.

claim: The Parent Feedback sub-module enforces parent-only ticket inception via the mobile application, omitting any admin creation controls on the web portal.
Top 4 KPI cards display aggregate school-year counts per status and function as reactive one-click table filter toggles with an explicit clear filter action.
notes: Dual KPI count and table filter cards.

claim: Tickets classify across 8 canonical categories with 4 color-coded priority tiers modifiable inline from table rows and detail view headers without confirmation dialogs.
notes: Inline priority modification and fixed category classification.

claim: A reactive turn-taking state machine alternates response expectation based on comment author identity and automatically reopens closed tickets upon new parent replies.
Terminal ticket closure is guarded by confirmation modal GY-01, while student and parent quick-view profile modals display secure contact details with fallback placeholders.
notes: Terminal closure modal GY-01 and read-only profile modals.

claim: The Academic Year module manages master temporal milestones, dynamically designating the active school year with a 'Hiện tại' badge based on automated system calendar calculation without manual toggle fields.
notes: Automated calendar-driven current academic year determination.

claim: The module strictly omits delete functionality across the UI, safeguarding master referential integrity across classes, student attendance, tuition invoices, meal fees, scoreboards, and parent feedback.
notes: Omission of delete operations to prevent orphan entity cascades.

claim: The creation and editing workflow uses a minimalist 3-field modal (Tên năm học, Ngày bắt đầu, Ngày kết thúc) with client-side date ordering validation (endDate >= startDate) and disabled submit button gating.
Instant client-side name search filtering enables rapid lookup of historical and upcoming academic periods, accompanied by bold blue styling for the current year and real-time total counter tallies.
notes: Client-side search and active year visual prominence.

claim: The sub-module is canonically mounted at /[schoolCode]/school/academic-year directly under the NHÀ TRƯỜNG sidebar navigation group after Lịch sự kiện with backward compatibility routing.
notes: Canonical sidebar navigation order and route topology.

claim: The School Archive (Lưu Trữ) sub-module provides an isolated cold-storage directory for withdrawn, transferred, and graduated students, strictly receiving records via unidirectional transition from the Học Sinh module with zero direct student creation actions.
notes: Cold storage directory with unidirectional inflow.

claim: Archived records tolerate optional nullability across withdrawal context attributes (Ngày lưu trữ, Lưu trữ bởi, Lý do), rendering clean empty cells without application errors or layout breakage.
notes: Metadata nullability tolerance in archive roster.

claim: Clicking an archived student's name opens an immutable read-only profile modal featuring an authoritative yellow warning banner ('🔒 Học sinh đã được lưu trữ') and specialized archive reason, date, and note fields.
notes: Archived student detail modal with yellow warning banner.

claim: Action handling enforces distinct modal dialogs for restoration (LT-01) and irreversible permanent deletion (LT-02) with differentiated visual illustrations and affirmative safeguards.
notes: Dual action modals with distinct visual safety cues.

claim: Restoring a student re-enacts active status in the Học Sinh module with class continuity logic: re-enrolling into their former class if active in the current academic year, or defaulting to unassigned ('Chưa xếp lớp') with an amber warning alert if inactive.
notes: Class continuity safeguard upon student restoration.

claim: School Profile form mandates School Name, Address, and Email with real-time inline validation (TR-01) upon field blur, while blocking submission until all required fields are valid.
notes: Basic info mandatory field inline validation and gating.

claim: Operating hours allow distinct start and end times for Monday through Saturday using 5-minute stepped time pickers, while designating Sunday as a static non-operational day without input controls.
notes: Monday-Saturday operating hours with static Sunday rest.

claim: Attendance threshold configuration is governed as an independent sub-form with its own submission action, supporting a late-arrival toggle with 5-60 minute stepped dropdown and a late-departure toggle cross-linking to tuition fee settings.
notes: Independent attendance rules sub-form and fee cross-link.

claim: Educational stage tiers, two-session attendance mode, and session attendance windows are strictly immutable read-only displays within the school profile, bearing administrative support contact advisories.
notes: Read-only education levels and attendance mode notices.

claim: Navigation away from either edit tab when unsaved form modifications exist triggers confirmation dialog TR-02 to prevent accidental loss of operational parameters.

The Account Management sub-module partitions User Accounts (/[schoolCode]/setting/users) and Student Accounts (/[schoolCode]/school/kid/accounts) into two dedicated operational tabs, supporting multi-role assignment for user profiles.
notes: Two-tab account architecture with multi-role assignment.

claim: Super-administrative security strictly locks the Admin role checkbox on account creation and limits existing Admin accounts to read-only inspection without edit or delete privileges.
notes: Admin account immutability and create gating.

claim: Accounts synchronized from national databases (CSDL Sở) are protected from local full-name alteration and row-level status toggling via field disablement and explicit error banners.
Account status toggling on the table roster applies immediately without confirmation, whereas edits inside the form require explicit modal confirmation TK-05 before persistence.
Email updates require a dedicated modal verification flow, and password resets are decoupled into a dedicated security sub-page with old credential expiration warnings.
notes: Decoupled email modal and password sub-page.

claim: Role-dependent form fields dynamically reveal Staff Functions (with 4 permissions and mandatory selection), Management Class assignments, and collapsible supplementary professional attributes.
Student login accounts maintain a 1-to-1 relationship with enrolled students, requiring format-validated alphanumeric/email usernames and providing account status filtering.
notes: Student account management and username format validation.

claim: The Face Recognition table roster renders state-driven data and action controls: unregistered students display '-' in Photo and Date with a single '+' action button, while registered students display real photo thumbnails, formatted dates, and pencil/delete action buttons.
notes: State-driven roster rendering and action duality.

claim: Registration and edit modals enforce strict demographic read-only integrity, binding Nickname, Gender, Date of Birth, and Class link from the authoritative student profile without allowing local tampering.
Submit actions in both registration and edit modals remain strictly disabled until a new image file is chosen via file upload, preventing empty submissions or accidental no-op overwrites.

Biometric deletion is guarded by an affirmative confirmation dialog that explicitly articulates the target student's full name, complying with sensitive data protection standards under Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP.
notes: Guarded deletion with explicit student name confirmation.

claim: Multi-factor filtering across student name/code, class selection, and two-state registration status ('Đã đăng ký' vs 'Chưa đăng ký') applies concurrently with AND conjunction and dynamic total counters.
notes: Multi-factor filtering and dynamic summary counters.

claim: The Face Recognition sub-module acts as the centralized master data authority for biometric facial references utilized downstream by optical gate attendance and AI media album auto-tagging.

The Feature Flags sub-module implements an independent two-route architecture where Tab Hoạt Động (/setting/activity/) and Tab Học Kỳ (/setting/period/) navigate separate routes, with Hoạt Động featuring two decoupled independent toggles for Comments and Comment Moderation.
notes: Independent two-route architecture and decoupled activity toggles.

claim: The Update action button on Tab Hoạt Động remains strictly disabled by default and enables exclusively when active toggle selections diverge from saved state, preventing redundant no-op mutations.

The Academic Terms tab binds dynamically to school academic years, defaulting to the ongoing academic year with an '(Hiện tại)' badge and enforcing a strict two-term ceiling per school year that disables the add term trigger when two terms exist.
notes: Academic year binding and two-term hard ceiling.

claim: Academic term creation and modification operate via pure inline table row editing using green checkmark save and gray X cancel icons, enforcing single-row mutual exclusion where all other row actions are locked during editing.
notes: Pure inline row editing with single-row mutual exclusion.

claim: Saved academic terms are permanent and omit deletion controls from the action column, while years with no registered terms render a dedicated clean placeholder row displaying 'Chưa có học kỳ'.
notes: Permanent saved terms without deletion and clean empty state.

claim: Activity comment toggles act as the centralized feature flag authority consumed downstream by class activity feeds and parent communication threads to govern comment visibility and moderation queues.
notes: Centralized feature flag authority for class activity comments.

claim: The Notification Configuration sub-module employs a monolithic single-form architecture with a unified bottom 'Cập nhật' action button governing all notification sections, with any change triggering dirty-state button activation.
notes: Monolithic single-form architecture and global dirty-state activation.

claim: Submitting notification configuration changes mandates an affirmative global confirmation modal ('Vui lòng xác nhận thay đổi cấu hình thông báo của trường!') prior to committing, preventing unintended institutional-wide communication changes.
notes: Mandatory global confirmation modal before committing.

claim: The top policy banner stipulates system-wide operational rules including multi-tenant school-wide enforcement, multi-platform uniformity, and the 31st-day calendar overflow fallback (scheduling on the last day of shorter months).
notes: Top policy banner invariants and calendar overflow rule.

claim: Birthday notification timing is configured via a shared date & time parameter row without an independent toggle, governing both teacher and administrator alert channels.
notes: Shared birthday parameter row without individual toggle.

claim: Delivery channel configuration features multi-channel asymmetry, providing independent dual toggles for 'Web & Ứng dụng' and 'Email' specifically on pending activities and daily logs.
notes: Multi-channel asymmetry with dual Web/App and Email toggles.

claim: Daily operational alert times (17:00 for teacher pickup reminder and 20:00 for daily diary review) are rendered as read-only fixed inputs with muted backgrounds.
Extracurricular attendance alerts support granular scope limitation, allowing administrators to target all extracurricular classes or isolate a specific class.
Tuition due alert schedules combine a relative timing selector ('Trước hạn đóng học phí' vs 'Sau hạn đóng học phí') with an integer day interval (1-31 days).
The parent notification section highlights operational trigger verbs ('điểm danh', 'hoạt động', 'album', 'hình/video') using orange visual accents to maximize cognitive clarity.
notes: Parent notification action keyword visual highlights.

claim: Notification settings act as the central operational broadcast authority across attendance, birthdays, tuition invoices, post approval queues, and parent updates.
